title: Clamp a Value
statement: Write a function `clamp(val, min, max)` that returns `min` if `val < min`, `max` if `val > max`, otherwise returns `val`.
example: clamp(15, 0, 10) returns 10; clamp(-5, 0, 10) returns 0; clamp(7, 0, 10) returns 7.
prewrittenHints: Check if the input falls outside the boundaries.
Output the lower bound if too small, or the upper bound if too large.
Otherwise preserve the original input value.
conceptNote: Clamping restricts numbers within allowed upper and lower bounds.
